description: Cross-language golden vectors for the canonical 93-byte TRION Behavioral Hash. Every implementation (Python core/streamer/FAISS, Rust trion-common + 21 indexer crates, TypeScript chains/shared/canonical_bh.ts) must reproduce payload_hex → sense/antisense byte-for-byte. Verified by tests/golden/test_golden_vectors.py: (a) Python doc-exact rebuild + repo builders, (b) static Rust source-order verification, (c) live TypeScript execution.
timestamp_rule: block time in unix seconds; 0 when unknown; never wall-clock

vectors.description: config/bh_schema_v1.json::test_vector — the frozen single-vector check (tests/unit/bh_cross_language_vector.py pins the same digests)
Rust hash_dna.rs::cross_language_canonical_bh_vector + scripts/cross_lang_bh_check.py parity vector (SWAP, chain 1)
Plain 1.5 ETH ERC20/native transfer on Ethereum (18 dp)
DEX swap of 250 POL-units on Polygon (18 dp, registry id 137)
MEV sandwich capture on Base (byte 16; registry id 8453)
AAVE-style flash loan of 1000 ETH on Ethereum — clamps magnitude to 1.0
Max u128-able raw amount (2^128-1 wei, 18 dp) — clamps to 1.0
Max u64 raw amount (2^64-1 wei, 18 dp) — clamps to 1.0
Zero-value tx — magnitude_nano 0, still a valid canonical event
Minimal payload: every field zero (entity 0x00*32, TRANSFER, ts 0, chain 0, block hash 0x00*32)
Truncation edge: 0.1234567895 × 1e9 = 123456789.5 — MUST truncate to 123456789 (a rounding implementation produces 123456790 and fails here)
1.5 units at 18 dp (raw 15×10^17) — the ETH-family normalization
1.5 units at 6 dp (raw 1_500_000, USDC-style) — same human amount, same magnitude_nano as the 18dp vector
3 SOL at 9 dp (raw 3×10^9 lamports, registry id 900)
12.34 ATOM at 6 dp (raw 12_340_000 uatom, registry id 10000)
5 XLM at 7 dp (raw 50_000_000 stroops, registry id 27000)
Identical event on chain_id 1 (registry semantics; u32 max case) — digests must differ across chain ids
Identical event on chain_id 900 (registry semantics; u32 max case) — digests must differ across chain ids
Identical event on chain_id 421614 (registry semantics; u32 max case) — digests must differ across chain ids
Identical event on chain_id 10000 (registry semantics; u32 max case) — digests must differ across chain ids
Identical event on chain_id 4294967295 (registry semantics; u32 max case) — digests must differ across chain ids
Block hash '0x0' (families without a hash in the payload) → 32 zero bytes
Odd-length hex (19 chars) — 9 bytes left-aligned, 19th nibble dropped, zero-padded right
Invalid hex chars decode as 0 ('zz' + '11'×31 → first byte 0x00, rest 0x11)
Uppercase hex decodes identically to lowercase ('AB'×32)
entity_id = SHA3-256(normalise(addr)) — the pinned bh_id vector (Rust cross_language_bh_id_vector / TS entityIdFromAddr)
Same address in upper vs lower case must produce the identical entity and identical digests (this vector uses the UPPERCASE form)
Non-EVM address forms pass through normalise unchanged (cosmos1… bech32 → sha3 of the raw string)
Non-EVM chains without an address use the deterministic per-tx sender SHA3-256('<chain>:<tx_hash>')
Non-zero context u64: venue=DEX (bit 0) + settlement=L2 (bits 2-3 → 4)
timestamp 0 — deterministic 'unknown block time' (families whose payload carries no block time)
Large timestamp (year 9999) — full u64 field width
